plugins.name: EasyCLIProxyAPI OpenCode Plugin
plugins.description: OpenCode Go provider (xspeed1989 fork): Responses tool-call lifecycle fix, tool-call id normalization (reasoning-free replays no longer fail with 400), chain-of-thought round-trip (client replay limited to the DeepSeek family), two-way credential reconciliation, and an OpenCode Go quota page. Renamed from opencode-go-cliproxyapi in v1.0.0; the provider name and model prefixes are unchanged.
plugins.author: babico
